label: A
sequence: Unbound completion -> design partner -> licensed platform -> more sponsors
reversibility: Medium: development is sunk once spent; licensing terms reversible
optionality: Keeps every later sequence open; Unbound becomes a referenceable product
dependencies: A channel partner willing to embed Unbound (HYP-010; V-6); SOC 2 at contract
opportunity_cost: Full founder time for the build and sales period

label: A3
sequence: Sequence A from a completed Unbound (S3): design partner -> licensed platform -> more sponsors
reversibility: High before a contract; commitments start at the term sheet
dependencies: A named partner; S3 actually reached
opportunity_cost: Full founder time during the sales period

label: B
sequence: Charity intelligence -> institutional relationships -> Unbound modules -> full platform
optionality: Low: narrow tools are acquired rather than expanded (P3-CLM-CD017)
dependencies: Registry implementation; DEC-004 redistribution limits; buyers with a gap versus Candid
opportunity_cost: Half the founder time diverted from the Unbound pilot

label: C
sequence: Transitus migration assessment -> migration services -> Unbound licensing
optionality: Transitus is needed by Unbound anyway (DEC-011)
dependencies: Incumbent export access (V-4); free migration is table stakes (CLM-021)
opportunity_cost: Founder time split between Transitus and Unbound

label: D
sequence: Compliance evidence and reconciliation -> institutional adoption -> broader financial workflow products
optionality: Low until controls above Designed exist
dependencies: Implemented controls and SOC history; a buyer budget for evidence
opportunity_cost: Full founder time on a service with weak buyer budget

label: E
sequence: New DAF programme enablement (host-sponsor programme factory) -> shared sponsor relationships -> platform expansion
reversibility: High (no long-term build commitment beyond templates)
optionality: High: each host network adds programmes without new procurement
dependencies: A design-partner host sponsor (P3-HYP-CD001); host-share rules; Unbound S4
opportunity_cost: Full founder time; programme onboarding labour

label: F
sequence: Existing Echelon component revenue -> internally funded Unbound
optionality: Credibility and diligence evidence; no funding capacity
dependencies: Owner licensing decision; commercial terms published (CNV-GOV-007)
opportunity_cost: A small share of founder time

label: G
sequence: Direct new DAF programme at an education or health foundation -> peer institutions -> hosting smaller peers
optionality: Converges with E once a host exists
dependencies: Programme minimum fee accepted; Unbound S4

label: H
sequence: Partner-embedded pilot with independence safeguards -> second partner -> multi-partner licensing (refines A)
optionality: Second partner before G2 limits concentration

label: A3B
sequence: Sequence A3 with the remaining S2-to-S3 build inside the DAF cost center
reversibility: Medium: development is sunk once spent
optionality: As A3; the build is paid before any partner test
dependencies: A named partner; S3 exit criteria (REV3001)
opportunity_cost: Full founder time for build and sales

label: A3X
sequence: Sequence A3 with the remaining S2-to-S3 build outside the DAF cost center (moves cost off the kill-rule clock; not a saving)
reversibility: Medium: development is sunk once spent
optionality: As A3; the build is paid before the clock starts
dependencies: A named partner; S3 exit criteria (REV3001); owner decision P3-DEC-MOD001
opportunity_cost: Full founder time for build and sales

label: PB
sequence: Partner-book licensing: a partner licenses a completed Unbound for its whole book of small sponsors (accounts aggregated; conversion per sponsor in the book)
reversibility: Medium: book conversion is the partner's commitment
optionality: High: one contract reaches many small sponsors
dependencies: A partner with a book (V-6); review allocation (P3-DEC-MOD005); book conversion capacity
